entities.title: Client redesign
entities.summary: Rebuild public/ to the approved design in design/: people × days week on desktop, one day at a time on a phone, schedule editor with a sidebar, household with colours and invites, invite-aware sign-in.
acceptanceCriteria: Every screen in design/screens/ matches its picture at 1280 px and 390 px width.
The week shows cancelled, moved, extra and alternate-week occurrences with their tags.
Every new string exists in Icelandic and English.
test/ui/ covers the week grid, the phone day view and the language toggle.

entities.title: Occurrences carry their status
entities.summary: expand() returns cancelled occurrences too, and every occurrence carries status (normal, cancelled, moved, extra), the exception note and its rule's every_n_weeks.
acceptanceCriteria: Cancelled occurrences keep the rule's times.

entities.title: A colour for every person
entities.summary: members.colour by migration, PATCH /people/:id and a colour on household members, editable by the person, by members for dependants, and by admins for anyone; /people returns colour for all.

entities.title: Import schedules from .ics and .zip files
entities.summary: A desktop import screen: parse .ics (and Google's .zip export) in the browser, review what becomes schedules and exceptions, and write it through one atomic endpoint. A one-time copy; subscribing to calendar links was declined. Mapping and limits in design/README.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Weekly and alternate-week series, EXDATE and RECURRENCE-ID overrides import as rules and exceptions.
One-off, monthly, yearly, all-day and past series are listed but not imported, with a reason.
An import that fails writes nothing.
A second household is untouched by an import in itest.sh.

entities.title: Invite preview before signing in
entities.summary: A public GET of an invite token's household name, inviter's first name and expiry, for the sign-in screen; 404 for anything unknown or expired.
